caption: The drawing depicts a line illustration of the interior of a desk, executed in black ink on a cream or beige background. The desk appears to have a slanted lid that folds down to reveal the interior compartments. Inside, there are multiple vertical and horizontal partitions forming six main pigeonhole compartments of varying sizes along the top row, each with a decorative edge at the top. Below these compartments, there are three rectangular drawers. The lid, which folds down to serve as a writing surface, is depicted with simple hinges, a lock in the center, and dimensional markings. The entire composition is centered within a rectangular border. At the bottom, handwritten text reads "Interior of Desk" and "Scale ⅜" = 1” in a script style. There is a faint signature in the bottom right corner.
title: Desk
